meta.name: data-analytics
meta.description: Create data pipeline and analytics architecture diagrams using PlantUML syntax with database/analytics stencil icons. Best for ETL pipelines, data lakes, real-time streaming, data warehousing, and BI dashboard design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 PlantUML 绘制数据管道与分析架构图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需用图表表达数据流转与架构设计
copy.tagline_en: Draw data pipeline and analytics architecture diagrams with PlantUML
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need diagrams to express data flow and architecture

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成数据管道和分析架构的 PlantUML 图，包括数据源、ETL、存储、BI 等组件。
howto.when: 当你要求绘制数据管道、数据湖、实时流处理、数据仓库或 BI 仪表板架构图时触发。

say.text: 用 Kinesis 和 Lambda 设计一个实时流处理架构图。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含流式组件的架构图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate PlantUML diagrams for data pipelines and analytics architectures, including data sources, ETL, storage, and BI components based on your description.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to draw diagrams for data pipelines, data lakes, real-time streaming, data warehouses, or BI dashboards.

say_en.text: Draw a data pipeline from S3 to Redshift to QuickSight.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the corresponding PlantUML code.

say_en.text: Design a real-time streaming architecture with Kinesis and Lambda.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a diagram with streaming components.
